text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Construction and Ecology ministry closes FENI ferro nickel factory in Kavadarci (east Macedonia) due to environment pollution.

- A turbulent weekend lies ahead -- central committee of the ruling SDAM to discuss relations between its coalition partners the Socialist party and the PDP ethnic Albanians. PDP to discuss whether to stay in the government coalition while the socialists to decide about the three ministers in the government coalition who refuse to obey orders of party president Ljubisav Ivanov.
- The parliament to discuss bill for an ombudsman submittted by government. With this Macedonia will fulfill promises given to U.N. special human rights envoy Elisabeth Rehn.
- A group of several senior Democratic Party members to present initative to preserve the party at its congress scheduled for beginning of March.
